patterns.note: The hero section features a large, abstract 'W' logo that is visually integrated with the main headline, creating a strong initial brand statement.
Upon scrolling, the large hero 'W' logo scales down and moves into the top navigation bar, which simultaneously transforms from transparent to a solid black sticky bar.
A high-contrast black and white color scheme dominates the branding and text, with natural wood tones from photography providing warmth and texture.
A monospaced font is consistently applied to body text, navigation links, and footer elements, giving the site a distinct, almost technical or editorial character.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections, often delineated by subtle background color changes between white and a very light grey.

technique_notes: The navigation bar implements a scroll-triggered transformation, where a large hero element (the 'W' logo) scales down and repositions itself into a fixed, compact navigation bar that changes its background color and text styling as the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
Content sections are presented with a clean, single-column layout, utilizing generous vertical whitespace to create an airy and uncluttered reading experience.
The site combines large, high-quality photography with concise, well-structured text blocks to convey information efficiently and visually.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) establish strong hierarchy, complemented by a smaller, consistent monospaced font for body and detail text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are used consistently across all interactive elements and content blocks.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks, creating a sense of openness and clarity.

standout: The most distinctive design element is the dynamic hero logo that seamlessly scales down and integrates into the sticky navigation bar upon scroll, providing a unique and branded transition. Additionally, the consistent use of a monospaced font for body text and navigation gives the site a unique, almost editorial or technical aesthetic that sets it apart from typical corporate designs.
